common.tagline: The right equipment. Right when you need it.

lang.bannerText: YantraMitra is available in Marathi, Hindi and English.

home.heroSubtitle: Tractors, rotavators, harvesters, sprayers and more, listed by owners in your area. Talk to the owner directly.
home.workTitle: What work do you need done?
home.nearbyEmpty: No equipment listed within {km} km yet.
home.how1Text: Choose your location and the work you need. See machines close to you.
home.how2Text: Log in to see the owner's number. Call or message them on WhatsApp.
home.how3Text: Settle the price, timing and conditions with the owner. YantraMitra takes no commission.
home.ctaText: List it for free and earn when it would otherwise stand idle.
